task.title: Build and preview the documentation
task.shortdesc: Install the plug-in and its dependencies, build the documentation map, and preview the generated site.

prereq.p: Use DITA-OT 4.x with Java 17 or later and Python 3.11 or later. Install the zip command to package the plug-in.

context.p: From a clone of this repository, package and install the plug-in. The GitHub release archive contains the same plug-in files.

step.cmd: Package the plug-in from the repository root.

info.codeblock: zip -r com.redhat.zensical.zip \ plugin.xml build_zensical.xml conductor.xml \ xsl python resources docs dita install com.redhat.zensical.zip

step.cmd: Install Zensical in the Python environment that will run the build.
Build the documentation map with the checked-in site configuration.
Start the local preview server from the output directory.

result.p: The preview is available at http://localhost:8000. The deployable static site is in out/site/. While the server is running, rebuild the DITA map after editing topics; Zensical reloads the updated output.
